purpose: Reusable economic mechanisms for CUBE hypothesis synthesis. Mechanisms are hypotheses until independently validated by external payment, fulfillment, and evidence.
promotion_rule: PROMOTE only after real external settlement + attribution + fulfillment + independent verification; REPEATABLE requires repeated demand.
